title: Wendi Richter and Cyndi Lauper: Rock ’n’ Wrestling
summary: Richter’s championship chase brings Cyndi Lauper and MTV into the wrestling story. Moolah and Leilani Kai stand between Richter and the title.

chapters.title: Richter wins on MTV
chapters.show: The Brawl to End It All
chapters.result: Wendi Richter defeats the Fabulous Moolah for the Women’s Championship.
chapters.context: Lauper supports Richter as wrestling and pop music meet in a televised title contest.

chapters.title: Richter regains the title
chapters.result: Richter defeats Leilani Kai, with Lauper and Moolah in opposing corners.
chapters.context: The title rivalry becomes part of the inaugural WrestleMania.
